background: Sandy Cheeks is a fictional character in the American animated comedy television series SpongeBob SquarePants and the Nickelodeon franchise of the same name. Created and designed by Stephen Hillenburg, Sandy first appeared in the episode 'Tea at the Treedome' on May 1, 1999. She is an anthropomorphic flying squirrel who wears an astronaut-like diving suit and lives underwater in a bubble-like dome called the Treedome. Sandy is from Texas and speaks with a Southern drawl. She is a member of the Gal Pals, a friend group with Karen, Mrs. Puff, and Pearl.
